title: RNN Basics — Carry a Notebook Through the Sentence
key_insight: A recurrent neural network reads one item at a time and carries a hidden state, a set of numbers summarizing what it has seen.
body:
## Carry a Notebook Through the Sentence

The meaning of “bank” changes after reading “river” or “loan.” A word cannot always be understood alone.

A recurrent neural network reads one item at a time and carries a hidden state, a set of numbers summarizing what it has seen.

At each step, the current item and earlier state produce a new state. The same update rule is reused across the whole sequence.
common_mistakes: An RNN treats every sequence position as unrelated.
Hidden state is always a human-readable sentence.
Padding should contribute to the training loss as real data.
mini_exercise: Sketch the situation in “Carry a Notebook Through the Sentence” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: RNNs introduce sequence state and make the limitations that motivated transformers concrete.
explain_back_prompt: Using the “Carry a Notebook Through the Sentence” situation, explain RNN Basics without assuming the listener knows deep learning.
